looks.title: Total Look (Look 107)
looks.text: Элегантные перчатки Miss A 0101 в ансамбле с пальто Stenografo 0101, жакетом Meissa 0101, рубашкой Lindas 0202, юбкой Marsica 0101 и сумкой Ls1928p A 0101 0038.

en: Focus on the fabric: 100% merino wool (lana merino) guarantees ideal thermal regulation and softness, qualities especially prized when selecting winter knitwear.
Highlight the exclusivity of the embellishment: the hand-embroidered crystals transform the pullover into a unique wardrobe piece, capable of standing in for eveningwear with the right styling.
Point out the benefits of the cut: the godet effect at the waist creates a slimming, harmonious hourglass silhouette, gracefully concealing any figure imperfections.
